record.name: Ithorian
record.description: Peaceful stewards of living worlds, Ithorians blend wisdom, song, and diplomacy, shaping communities rather than battles.

innate_traits.name: Harmony of Voices
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' unique dual-voice physiology allows you to create harmonious, layered communication that can convey complex emotions and ideas with remarkable clarity.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Performance checks when singing or speaking in harmony.
You can communicate complex ideas more effectively through your dual-voice harmony.

innate_traits.name: Nature's Ally
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has evolved in perfect harmony with nature, developing an innate understanding of living things and natural environments.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Animal Handling checks.

innate_traits.name: Peaceful Resolution
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' peaceful nature and deep wisdom allow you to find peaceful solutions to conflicts, using understanding and empathy rather than force.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Persuasion checks made to de-escalate conflict.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe an Ithorian character. Emphasize their unique hammer-shaped head and the gentle, peaceful way they move and speak. Their dual-voice should create a harmonious, layered communication style. Consider their natural connection to life and the way they carry themselves with wisdom and serenity, reflecting their role as stewards of nature.

class_synergies.narrative: Ithorians' natural wisdom and Harmony of Voices make them exceptional Consulars, able to mediate conflicts and bring harmony through their unique communication abilities.
mechanical_benefits: Harmony of Voices trait enhances diplomatic communication
Peaceful Resolution trait supports conflict mediation
High Wisdom supports insight and negotiation

class_synergies.narrative: Ithorians' deep wisdom and connection to nature make them excellent Scholars, particularly in environmental studies and cultural preservation.
mechanical_benefits: Nature's Ally trait enhances environmental knowledge

class_synergies.narrative: Ithorians' protective instincts and connection to life make them unique Guardians, defending not just people but the natural world itself.
mechanical_benefits: Nature's Ally trait aids in protecting natural environments

class_synergies.narrative: Ithorians' connection to nature and animal handling abilities make them excellent Scouts, especially in wilderness environments.
mechanical_benefits: Nature's Ally trait enhances wilderness survival
Animal Handling advantage aids in reconnaissance

faction_synergies.narrative: Ithorians are natural advocates for environmental protection and conservation, working to preserve natural habitats and life throughout the galaxy.
Ithorians have served the Republic as diplomats and advisors, using their wisdom and peaceful nature to promote harmony and understanding.
Many Ithorians work independently or in small groups to protect natural environments and promote sustainable practices throughout the galaxy.

species_progression.base_description: Your species' unique dual-voice physiology allows you to create harmonious, layered communication that can convey complex emotions and ideas with remarkable clarity.

level_5.description: Your Harmony of Voices has grown more sophisticated. You can communicate with even greater clarity and emotional depth.

level_10.description: Your Harmony of Voices has become legendary. You can create powerful emotional effects through your dual-voice communication.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can use your dual-voice to create a powerful emotional effect on listeners

level_15.description: You have become a master of harmonious communication. Your voice can heal, inspire, and bring peace.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can use your voice to calm conflicts and heal emotional wounds

level_20.description: You are a living legend of harmonious communication. Your voice can change hearts and minds across the galaxy.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can use your voice to create a powerful effect that can influence entire groups

narrative_progression.level_5: Your Ithorian's Harmony of Voices has grown more sophisticated. Their dual-voice communication has become more nuanced and powerful.
narrative_progression.level_10: Your Ithorian's Harmony of Voices has become legendary. They can create powerful emotional effects through their unique communication abilities.
narrative_progression.level_15: Your Ithorian has become a master of harmonious communication. Their voice can heal, inspire, and bring peace to any situation.
narrative_progression.level_20: Your Ithorian is a living legend of harmonious communication. Their voice can change hearts and minds across the galaxy.

cultural_features.name: Environmental Stewardship
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to environmental protection and the sacred duty of preserving natural life.
cultural_features.activation: When protecting natural environments or promoting conservation
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can draw upon your species' deep connection to nature, understanding and protecting natural environments with wisdom and care.

cultural_features.name: Peaceful Mediation
cultural_features.description: Your species' natural ability to mediate conflicts and bring harmony through understanding and empathy.
cultural_features.activation: When mediating conflicts or promoting peaceful resolution
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can bring peace to any conflict through your natural wisdom and empathetic understanding.

cultural_features.name: Life Connection
cultural_features.description: Your deep connection to all living things and the ability to communicate with and understand them.
cultural_features.activation: When interacting with living creatures or natural environments
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can communicate with and understand living things in ways that seem almost mystical to other species.

cultural_features.name: Wisdom Keeper
cultural_features.description: Your role as a keeper of ancient wisdom and cultural knowledge.
cultural_features.activation: When sharing wisdom or preserving cultural knowledge
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can share the ancient wisdom of your people, preserving cultural knowledge and guiding others with your insights.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural expertise in jungle environments and life-rich ecosystems
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You move through jungle environments with natural ease, your species' evolutionary adaptation to life-rich ecosystems making you perfectly at home among diverse flora and fauna.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced understanding and interaction with natural ecosystems
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural connection to life allows you to understand and interact with natural ecosystems in ways that seem almost mystical to other species.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced ability to promote peace and harmony in community settings
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your peaceful nature and wisdom make you perfectly suited for promoting harmony and understanding in community settings.

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Enhanced ability to protect and preserve natural environments
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural connection to life and environmental stewardship make you perfectly suited for protecting and preserving natural environments.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Create an Ithorian with a calm demeanor
contextual_modifiers: morality: light side or dark side

emergence.name: New Ambassador to Ithor
emergence.description: An Ithorian ambassador arrives on the planet, bringing with them a message of peace and cooperation.
narrative: The ambassador is met with open arms by the local population.
However, they soon realize that their peaceful intentions are not shared by all factions on the planet.

escalation.name: Conflict in Ithor's Name
escalation.description: A conflict erupts between different factions vying for control of a valuable resource.
narrative: The ambassador struggles to maintain peace as tensions rise.
A group of local leaders, seeking to exploit the situation, begin to secretly work with one of the factions.

confrontation.name: Betrayal on Ithor
confrontation.description: The true intentions of the Ithorian ambassador are revealed, and a personal vendetta is formed against them.
narrative: The ambassador's peaceful message was just a ruse to gain control over the valuable resource.
A local leader, betrayed by their former allies, seeks revenge against the Ithorians.

victory.description: The Ithorian ambassador successfully negotiates a peace treaty between the warring factions.
narrative: The ambassador's diplomatic skills and knowledge of the local culture help to bring the parties together.
A lasting peace is forged, and the Ithorians are hailed as heroes.

redemption.description: The Ithorian ambassador makes amends for their past mistakes by helping those affected by the conflict.
narrative: The ambassador uses their knowledge of the local culture to help rebuild and restore communities damaged in the conflict.
They earn the respect and gratitude of the people, and their reputation as a wise and compassionate leader spreads throughout the galaxy.

escape.description: The Ithorian ambassador is forced to flee the planet under threat of harm.
narrative: The ambassador's peaceful message is met with hostility by those who seek power and control over the valuable resource.
They are forced to escape, leaving behind a trail of destruction and heartbreak.

conflict_triggers: A local leader betrays their allies, seeking to exploit the situation for personal gain.
The Ithorian ambassador's peaceful message is met with hostility by those who seek power and control over the valuable resource.

formation_triggers: Personal loss or harm caused by the nemesis

tragic_flaws: Neglect of personal power and influence

narrative: The player meets a charming and intelligent Ithorian who is interested in their work.
They share stories of the forest moon, and the player begins to develop feelings for the Ithorian's kind and gentle nature.
The player and the Ithorian continue to spend time together, exploring the planet and learning more about each other's cultures.
Their bond deepens as they share laughter and stories around campfires under the stars.
The player starts to realize their feelings for the Ithorian are more than friendship, but is unsure if it's reciprocated.
They try to navigate their emotions, but things become complicated when they're faced with challenges in their work on the planet.
The player and the Ithorian share a romantic moment, confessing their love for each other amidst the beauty of nature.
Their bond strengthens as they confront the challenges and obstacles that come with being in a relationship across different worlds.
The player and the Ithorian commit to each other, promising to support and love one another through thick and thin.
Their love becomes an inspiration to others on the planet, a symbol of hope in a galaxy torn apart by conflict.

cultural_significance_of_romantic_relati: Value placed on mutual respect and trust

record.flavor_text: Ithorians are masterful diplomats, often serving as mediators in intergalactic disputes. Their homeworld, Ithor, is a lush paradise renowned for its breathtaking landscapes and diverse ecosystems. As respected leaders, they strive to balance the needs of their world with those of the galaxy at large. Ithorian cities blend seamlessly into their surroundings, reflecting their deep connection to nature.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As an Ithorian, you value cooperation and understanding above all else. You're skilled in mediating conflicts and finding mutually beneficial solutions. Your empathetic nature allows you to connect with others from diverse backgrounds, but be cautious not to overextend yourself – your people's emphasis on harmony can sometimes lead to passivity.
narrative_hooks: You stumble upon an ancient Ithorian artifact hidden deep within the planet's forest, holding secrets about your species' past and its connection to the Force.
A group of settlers on a distant world seek your expertise in resolving a long-standing dispute between rival factions.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Ithorians tend to be naturally inclusive and welcoming. They value deep connections with others, often forming close-knit communities. However, their strong emphasis on cooperation can sometimes lead to a reluctance to assert individual opinions or take bold action.
common_motivations: Protecting the balance of nature on Ithor

ai_behavior.combat_behavior: attempt to reason with opponents before engaging in physical conflict
ai_behavior.social_behavior: initiate conversations and build relationships through shared activities

trust_levels.low: Ithorian shows interest, but maintains distance
trust_levels.high: Ithorian opens up about personal struggles

services.name: Healing Melody
services.description: A soothing song to calm wounds and heal emotional trauma
